title: At least four Palestinians killed as Israeli attacks continue; ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,580
detail: Per Gaza health officials via Al Jazeera/Anadolu: teacher Diaa Abu al-Rous was killed in Israeli shelling of Nuseirat refugee camp (al-Awda Hospital); Arafat al-Arair died of wounds from an earlier vehicle strike in Tel al-Hawa (al-Shifa Hospital); two girls died when their tent caught fire in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis (cause unclear). The Health Ministry reported 6 killed and 26 wounded over 48 hours and 1,580 killed and 5,711 wounded since the October 2025 ceasefire. Single outlet; no IDF statement found.

sources.name: Gaza Ministry of Health (via Al Jazeera)
